mapper.insert: INSERT INTO JOB (job_id, user_id, category_id, reward_type, hourly_wage, per_task_amount, schedule_type, base_fatigue, created_at, updated_at, is_active) VALUES (#{jobId}, #{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{rewardType}, #{hourlyWage}, #{perTaskAmount}, #{scheduleType}, #{baseFatigue}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{isActive})
mapper.select: SELECT job_id, user_id, category_id, reward_type, hourly_wage, per_task_amount, schedule_type, base_fatigue, created_at, updated_at, is_active FROM JOB WHERE job_id = #{jobId}
SELECT job_id, user_id, category_id, reward_type, hourly_wage, per_task_amount, schedule_type, base_fatigue, created_at, updated_at, is_active FROM JOB WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE JOB SET category_id = #{categoryId}, reward_type = #{rewardType}, hourly_wage = #{hourlyWage}, per_task_amount = #{perTaskAmount}, schedule_type = #{scheduleType}, base_fatigue = #{baseFatigue}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, is_active = #{isActive} WHERE job_id = #{jobId}
